tei:div.tei:p: (443)༄༅/ bde ba can du bsgrod pa'i cho ga dpag med myur lam gtong tshul ni/

rtsa gtor/ bla gtor/ zhal zas brgya sogs ci 'dzoms/ dkar bgegs/ cha gsum/ zhi sbyong gsum/ drag sbyong gsum/ khrus bum/ me long*/ sngags bye/ yungs dkar/ 'byung bzhi/ zas bsngo/ mar me brgya/ yon chab bcu/ khrus dar sogs nye bar bsdog cho ga dngos la/ sems skyed sdom chog gnas lugs pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yan/ e ma ho: rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba'i= badzra shṝ ma hā= bdag gi= raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ swa bha wa= stong pa= oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu tā= sarba bighānaṃ a ka ro= gsum/ sarba bhighānaṃ gatstsha/ sum bha ni= rol/ dung*/ dkar/ rkang bzhi/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ rdor gsor/ dril bu gnyis rdung bya/ yid la= dril bsil/ zhi rol/ dkar/ bhū mi pa ti ya hi gatstsha/ rang gi snying ga'i= mgon po dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs= sangs rgyas= gsum/ sems can thams cad= gsum/ byang chub snying por= gsum/ de rnams khrus gdangs dang lhug spel/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ thams cad du yang= yo ga bzhi dril/ shū n+ya ta= hrī: mkha' khyab= yo ga bzhi dril/ ma ṇi stong*/ swa bha wa= stong pa'i= zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ shū n+ya ta= gzung 'dzin ltar snang= sman gdangs/ ma lus sems can= yo ga bzhi dril/ zhi rol/ rgya/dkar/ dung*/ yo ga bzhi dril kho nas/ bcom ldan 'dir ni= de bzhin gshegs pa=(444)mi bgyid do/ lha khrus phyag len spyi ltar la/ khrus gdangs/ khrus kyi khang pa= rol mor bcas pa= zhi phyed rol/ rgya/ dkar/ ji ltar bltams pa= yo ga bzhi dril kho nas/ phyed rol/ bla ma mnyam med= rol/ bslu med dkon mchog= rol/ gang tshe rkang gnyis= rol/ rlabs chen spyod pa'i= rol/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor= rol/ rgyal ba kun yum= rol/ sngon tshe o rgyan= rol/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs= rol/ de dag sku la= nar 'gros/ sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ dam chos dkon mchog=

yo ga bzhi dril/ mdun bskyed= lhug/ bsnyen pa brgya/ bzang spyod/ ji snyed su dag= me tog= na bza'= mchod pa= mchod gzungs/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang= 'das pa'i sangs rgyas= nas/ ngan song rgyud rnams ma lus stongs par shog bar des 'gres/ bsnyen pa brgya/ bzang spyod spel mas bzang spyod tshar nyer lnga song dus/ zangs mdog dpal ri'i smon lam bton te zhog tshogs grol/ mdun bskyed gsung rdo rje'i= bsnyen dmigs dang*/ bsnyen pa brgya/ bzang spyod tshar re spel mas/ bzang spyod nyer lnga song ba dang*/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i smon lam gyis tsha rting grol/ yang bsnyen dmigs tshar gcig bsnyen pa brgya/ bzang spyod tshar re/ tshar nyer lnga song ba dang*/ sku gsum zhing sbyong smon lam gyis/ gung tshigs bya ste dwangs chen grol/ yang (445) bsnyen dmigs/ bsnyen pa brgya re dang*/ bzang spyod tshar re sbrags pas tshar nyer lnga song dus bar do'i smon lam dgongs cig rgya mtsho dang*/ dus mthar gdab pa'i smon lam gyis bar tshogs snga ma grol/ snying gar padma 'dab bzhi'i= hrīḥ stong tsam/ hrīḥ snod bcud 'od= khrus bum du= trāṃ a garbha= sum brgya tsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lha 'od du zhu bas bum chu bdud rtsir gyur/ gnas 'dren gyi phyag len rnams thugs rje chen po ltar la/ 'don lugs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las= na mo/ rje btsun= gsum/ sarba bighnaṃ= gsum/ sum bha ni= gsum/ zhi rol/ dung chen/ rkang*/ badzra dzwa la= me rgya/ oṃ sho dha ni= dril bsil/ bye yungs brab/ tshar nyer cig gam/ bdun gsum gang rung*/ 'od dpag med mgon= yo ga bzhi dril/ dug khrus/ rol mo re/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ tsho drug de 'dra re/ 'dod chags zhe sdang*/ bum sgros byab/ sa ni= yo ga kho nas/ byang chub snying por= mthar zhi rol/ dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang*/ a ka ro= 'gro ba gang dag= na mo/ bdag gi= yo ga bzhi dril/ bstan pa yin// 'dod yon nam mkha'i=

phyogs rnams kun na= yo ga bzhi dril/ nyon cig= der gshegs shig sbyang bya'i rnam shes hūm̐ gi rnam pa bde ba can du gshegs par gyur/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= bcom ldan 'das rdul bral shin tu= bde smon 'don zhor byang bu zhugs la sbar/ gsol ka yongs rdzogs dang*/ gser skyems (446) mthar/ bar tshogs phyi ma grol/ gsol ka'i gtor 'gugs nas bkra shis yan/ rtsa gdangs kyis/ gal te bdag gi= 'gro kun= sems can= ye dharma= phun sum tshogs pa= zhi rol brgyud phyed bzhi/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ rkang*/ bzang spyod/ dngos grub rgya mtsho'i= gang du= bskal mang= chos tshul= bcas// dge'o//
